title: 第七十六章 太清演卦知危局 玉帝遣天兵镇灵山第七十五章 二圣临凡镇天罚 力挺如来驯玉盘
content_zh:
灵山雷音宝殿内，接引、准提二圣坐镇两侧，混元圣威绵延千里。如来端坐九品莲台，掌心玉盘被层层混沌圣纹缠裹，躁动的苍生道韵日渐温顺，驯化进程稳步推进。万佛诵经之声连绵不绝，整座灵山一派鼎盛气象，连日来的天罚、内讧、危机尽数烟消云散。
如来目视殿外云海，神色沉稳，心中却始终悬着一块巨石。幽狱之中的四位神君，乃是心腹大患。此四人与玉盘本命相连，道根扎根苍生天道，纵然身陷囹圄、饱受刑苦，依旧底蕴难测，一日不彻底镇压清算，驯盘大业便始终存有隐患。
他沉吟片刻，对着二圣躬身言道：“二位圣人，如今天罚已平，玉盘渐被收服，可幽狱四君执念不消、潜力难估。眼下虽有佛门大阵封禁囚笼，可四人身负天命，变数无穷。若任由其蛰伏蓄力，恐日后再生波澜，坏我全盘大计。”
准提道人目光穿透地层，望向万丈地底的万佛幽狱，淡淡开口：“你心中所想，我二人了然。四君道基圆满，又与玉盘气息相通，寻常禁制难以彻底困杀。只是我西方二圣久驻灵山，已然引三界瞩目，不便再大肆出手强攻，徒增非议与业力。”
接引道人微微颔首：“依我之见，可修书传往天庭，请玉帝依三界法度出面，调天兵下界协防，以周天阵法叠加封禁，严防四君异动。借天庭正统之力锁死囚笼，方为万全之策。”
如来连连称是，当即提笔拟写表章，遣使送往三十三天凌霄宝殿。表中只言四君囚居幽狱、暗藏异心，恐有破狱之险，恳请天庭增派兵力，强化灵山防务，稳守大局。
表文破空而上，转瞬抵达凌霄宝殿。玉帝阅览之后，权衡片刻，便下令调遣一部分天兵，先行赶往灵山，协助佛门加固阵法、巡视囚狱。首批天兵领命出征，浩浩荡荡奔赴西土。
三界各方势力见状，皆以为此事就此落幕。仙佛联手设防，幽狱四君插翅难飞，灵山大局已然稳固。
无人知晓，此刻三十三天外八景宫内，另有一番光景。
八景宫云雾缭绕，玄光氤氲，一派清宁太古气象。太清道德天尊静坐蒲团之上，身前先天八卦图缓缓轮转，阴阳鱼首尾相衔，万千卦象不断演化流转。这位三界辈分最高、道行深不可测的混元圣人，素来不问三界纷争、不涉仙佛博弈，一心静守清修、推演大道。
今日却忽然双目微睁，目光落向灵山方向，眉宇间掠过一丝凝重。
身旁侍立的玄都大法师见状，上前躬身问道：“师尊，卦象异动，可是三界有变？”
太清抬手轻指八卦图，卦纹明暗交错，凶隐于吉，危伏于安：“方才推演天地气运，灵山方向看似佛运昌隆、大势平稳，实则内里暗流汹涌，杀机暗藏。幽狱之内那四位执掌苍生道韵的神君，如今身陷重围，外有佛门重重禁制，又逢天庭天兵压境，大难临头，性命堪忧。”
玄都面色一凛：“那四君本是顺天守道、执掌苍生秩序之人，无端遭此困厄，已然委屈。如今仙佛联手步步紧逼，当真要赶尽杀绝？”
“非只如此。”太清声线古朴悠远，道破更深玄机，“四君身负天道本源、苍生气运，乃是维系三界平衡的关键枢纽。他们若在此番围剿之下折损，苍生道链便会断裂，天道秩序出现巨大缺口。短期之内灵山佛运看似独盛，可用不了多久，天地失衡、灾劫丛生，三界都要跟着蒙受大祸。”
他指尖一点，八卦图上灵光暴涨，显现出灵山、幽狱、天庭三方气机交织的画面：“眼下佛门阵法、先期天兵，看似牢不可破，却仍有疏漏。四君底蕴超凡，绝境之中必有拼命反击之举。一旦双方彻底死战，灵山会被战火重创，天庭出兵将士也会深陷险地，损兵折将。”
玄都恍然大悟：“原来如此。师尊是担忧四君遇难引发连锁祸乱，也不愿天庭兵马无端折损。那我等当如何处置？”
太清缓缓起身，白袖轻拂，一股平和却掌控诸天的圣气漫出八景宫：“三界秩序，环环相扣，一损俱损。四君有难，便是天道有缺。玉帝已然遣兵前往灵山，可兵力不足、阵法不全，难以控住全局，反倒容易激化矛盾。”
话音落下，太清圣音穿透云海，直抵三十三重天凌霄宝殿，响彻整座天庭：
“玉帝听言！灵山幽狱四君身陷危局，当下封禁尚有破绽，先期兵力不足以镇住场面。

此四人关联苍生气运、牵扯天地道基，万万不可令其骤然倾覆，亦不可让兵戈失控、酿成巨祸。
即刻整备大军，再发重兵赶赴灵山！
以天罗地网大阵全面笼罩整座灵鹫山，封锁八方虚空，隔断内外联络，稳住战局、控住双方，既防四君突围搏命，亦阻佛门过激行事，护三界气运不失！”
圣音浩荡，不容置疑。太清圣人久居世外，极少过问朝堂事务，此番亲自传下法旨，三界仙神无不心惊。
凌霄宝殿之上，玉皇大帝端坐帝座，骤然听闻太清圣谕，神色一正，连忙起身拱手遥拜八景宫方向。殿下文武仙卿、诸天将官尽数肃立，不敢有半分懈怠。
玉帝心中了然，太清圣人道法通天，推演乾坤从无差错。圣人特意点醒，足见灵山局势远非表面那般安稳，四君潜藏的力量、背后牵动的因果，远比众人想象的更为复杂。若是遵照此前的部署，只凭少量兵马驻守，早晚要生出大乱。
“谨遵太清圣人法旨！”
玉帝收回目光，重新落座，冕旒垂珠微动，天威席卷大殿，高声传下旨意：
“先前赴灵山的兵马暂且原地驻守，严加戒备。
如今圣人示警，幽狱局势凶险，防务不可松懈！
传朕诏令：再度调集十五万天兵天将，增补各路神将、星宿、雷部正神！
托塔天王李靖总领全军，哪吒太子依旧为先锋，四大天王分守四方天门，二十八宿排布星阵，九曜星官掌控气机，雷公电母随时策应！
全军即刻开拔，再赴灵山！
一、叠加周天锁神大阵，将万佛幽狱层层包裹，不留一丝缝隙；
二、隔绝空间挪移之术，封锁整片灵山空域，任何人不得随意出入；
三、严守中立控局，压制双方过激举动，不令战火肆意蔓延；
content_en:
In the Leiyin Palace of Lingshan, the two saints Jieyin and Zhunti sit on both sides, and the power of the Holy Spirit of Hunyuan stretches for thousands of miles. The Tathagata is sitting on the Nine-Rank Lotus Platform, with the jade plate in his palm wrapped in layers of chaotic sacred patterns. The restless Taoist charm of the common people is becoming gentler and gentler, and the domestication process is advancing steadily. The sound of thousands of Buddhas chanting sutras continued continuously, and the entire Lingshan Mountain was in a prosperous atmosphere. The punishments, internal strife, and crises in the past few days have all disappeared.
Tathagata looked at the sea of ​​clouds outside the hall, his expression calm, but there was always a huge stone hanging in his heart. The four divine kings in the underworld are a serious nuisance. These four people are connected to the fate of Jade Pan, and their Taoist roots are rooted in the common people and heaven. Even though they are imprisoned and tortured, their backgrounds are still unpredictable. If they are not completely suppressed and liquidated, there will always be hidden dangers in the great cause of taming Pan.
He pondered for a moment, then bowed to the two saints and said: "Two saints, now that the punishment has been leveled and the jade plate is gradually subdued, the four kings of the hell are still obsessed with it and their potential is hard to estimate. Although there is a Buddhist formation to seal the cage, the four of them are responsible for the destiny and the variables are endless. If they are allowed to lie dormant and accumulate strength, I am afraid that there will be waves in the future and ruin my overall plan."
Taoist Zhunti looked through the ground and looked at the Hell of Ten Thousand Buddhas under the ground. He said calmly: "I and I understand what you are thinking. The Four Monarchs have perfect Taoist foundations and are connected with the aura of the jade plate. It is difficult to completely trap them under ordinary restrictions. It's just that I, the two sages in the West, have been stationed in Lingshan for a long time and have attracted the attention of the three worlds. It is inconvenient to launch a large-scale attack, which will only increase criticism and karma."
The leading Taoist nodded slightly: "In my opinion, you can compile a book and send it to the heaven. Ask the Jade Emperor to come forward according to the laws of the three realms, mobilize the heavenly soldiers to help defend, and use the Zhoutian formation to superimpose the seal to prevent the four kings from moving. The only way to lock the death cage is to use the orthodox power of the heaven to lock the death cage."
The Tathagata repeatedly said yes, immediately took up a pen to write a seal, and sent an envoy to the Thirty-Three Heavens Lingxiao Hall. The table only states that the four princes are imprisoned in a dark prison, hiding their different intentions, and may be in danger of breaking out of the prison. They implore the heaven to send more troops to strengthen the defense of Lingshan and stabilize the overall situation.
Biaowen flew up through the air and arrived at the Lingxiao Palace in an instant. After the Jade Emperor read it, weighed it for a moment, and then ordered some heavenly soldiers to be dispatched to Lingshan to assist the Buddhists in strengthening the formation and inspecting the prison. The first batch of heavenly soldiers were ordered to go out and rush to the Western Territory in a mighty manner.
Upon seeing this, all the forces in the three realms thought that the matter was over. Immortals and Buddhas have joined forces to set up defenses, and the four kings of the hell have no wings to fly. The overall situation of Lingshan has been stabilized.
No one knew that there was something else going on in the Eight Views Palace thirty-three days away at this moment.
The Eight Views Palace is shrouded in clouds and mist, and the mysterious light is dense, giving it an ancient atmosphere of Qingning. Taiqing Daode Tianzun sits quietly on a futon, with the innate eight diagrams in front of him slowly rotating, the yin and yang fish holding their heads and tails, and thousands of hexagrams constantly evolving and circulating. This Hunyuan Saint, who has the highest seniority in the three realms and unfathomable Taoism, has never been involved in the disputes in the three realms or the game between immortals and Buddhas. He has devoted himself to practicing pure cultivation and deducing the great road.
Today, his eyes suddenly opened slightly, and his gaze fell in the direction of Lingshan, with a trace of solemnity passing between his eyebrows.
Seeing this, the Great Master Xuandu who was standing beside him stepped forward and bowed and asked: "Master, the hexagrams are changing, but are there changes in the three realms?"
Taiqing raised his hand and pointed lightly at the Bagua diagram. The hexagram patterns were intertwined with light and dark, and the evil was hidden in the good, and the danger was hidden: "I have just deduced the destiny of heaven and earth. The direction of Lingshan seems to be prosperous and stable, but in fact, there are turbulent undercurrents inside, and murderous intentions are hidden. The four gods in the hell who are in charge of the Tao of the common people are now trapped in a tight siege. There are many restrictions from Buddhism outside, and the heavenly troops are pressing down on the situation. A disaster is imminent, and their lives are at risk."
Xuandu's face turned stern: "Those four monarchs were originally people who obeyed the principles of heaven and were in charge of the order of the common people. They have been in such trouble for no reason. They are already aggrieved. Now the immortals and Buddhas have joined forces to press forward step by step. Are they really going to kill them all?"
"It's not just that." Taiqing's voice was simple and far-reaching, revealing a deeper mystery. "The Four Monarchs are responsible for the origin of Heaven's Dao and the fate of the common people. They are the key hubs that maintain the balance of the three realms. If they are damaged under this encirclement and suppression, the chain of the Dao of the common people will be broken, and there will be a huge gap in the order of Heaven's Dao. In the short term, Lingshan's Buddhist destiny seems to be the only one, and it cannot be used.How long will it take for the world to become unbalanced and disasters to arise, and the three realms will all suffer great disasters? "
With his fingertips, the spiritual light on the Bagua diagram surged, showing the intertwined qi of Lingshan, Netherworld, and Heaven: "Right now, the Buddhist formations and advanced heavenly weapons seem to be indestructible, but there are still some loopholes. The four monarchs have extraordinary backgrounds, and they must fight back desperately in desperate situations. Once the two sides fight to the death, Lingshan will be severely damaged by the war, and the soldiers sent by Heaven will be in danger, losing troops and generals. "
Xuandu suddenly realized: "That's it. The Master is worried that the death of the Four Lords will cause a chain of disasters, and he does not want the troops of Heaven to be damaged for no reason. So what should I do? "
Taiqing stood up slowly, flicking his white sleeves, and a peaceful yet controlling holy energy spread out of the Bajing Palace: "The order of the three realms is interlocked, and if one is damaged, all will be damaged. If the four kings are in trouble, it means that the way of heaven is lacking. The Jade Emperor has already sent troops to Lingshan, but the troops are insufficient and the formations are incomplete, making it difficult to control the overall situation and tending to intensify conflicts. "
After the words fell, the pure holy voice penetrated the sea of clouds, reached the Lingxiao Palace on the 33rd level, and resounded throughout the entire heaven:
"The Jade Emperor listens! The four kings of Lingshan Hell are in a critical situation. There are still flaws in the current ban, and the initial troops are not enough to suppress the situation.
These four people are related to the fate of the people and the foundation of heaven and earth. They must not be allowed to overturn suddenly, nor let the war get out of control and cause a huge disaster.
Prepare the army immediately and send heavy troops to Lingshan!
The entire Lingjiu Mountain is completely covered with a large formation of heaven and earth net, blocking the void in all directions, cutting off communication between the inside and outside, stabilizing the battle situation, and controlling both sides. It not only prevents the Four Lords from breaking out and fighting for their lives, but also prevents the Buddhists from overacting, and protects the fate of the three realms! "
The holy voice is so majestic that there is no doubt about it. The Saint Taiqing had lived outside the world for a long time and rarely interfered with the affairs of the court. This time he personally handed down the decree, which shocked all the immortals and gods in the three realms.
Above the Lingxiao Palace, the Jade Emperor was sitting on his throne. He suddenly heard the Taiqing Holy Edict, his expression became serious, and he quickly stood up and bowed in the direction of the Eight Views Palace. Your Royal Highness, all the civil servants, immortal ministers and generals from heaven all stood in awe, not daring to slack off even a little bit.
The Jade Emperor knew clearly in his heart that the Taiqing Sage's Tao and Dharma reached the heavens, and there was no mistake in deducing the universe. The saint's special reminder shows that the situation in Lingshan is far from as stable as it appears. The hidden power of the Four Lords and the cause and effect behind it are far more complicated than everyone imagined. If the previous deployment is followed and only a small number of troops are stationed, chaos will occur sooner or later.
“I will obey the decree of the Taiqing Sage! "
The Jade Emperor withdrew his gaze and sat down again. The beads on his crown moved slightly, and the power of God swept across the hall, loudly announcing his decree:
"The soldiers and horses that went to Lingshan earlier will stay in place for the time being and be on strict alert.
Now the saint warns that the situation in the underworld is dangerous and the defense must not be relaxed!
My edict is passed down: once again mobilize 150,000 heavenly soldiers and generals, and recruit all kinds of divine generals, Xingxiu, and Thunder Gods!
Li Jing, the king of Tota, leads the entire army. Prince Nezha is still the vanguard. The four heavenly kings guard the four heavenly gates. The twenty-eight constellations arrange the star formations. The nine-obsidian star officer controls the energy mechanism. The Thunder God and the Lightning Mother are ready to assist!
The whole army sets off immediately and goes to Lingshan again!
1. Superimpose the Zhoutian Locking God Formation to wrap up the Hell of Ten Thousand Buddhas layer by layer without leaving a single gap;
2. The technique of isolating space movement, sealing the entire Lingshan airspace, and no one is allowed to enter or exit at will;
3. Strictly maintain neutral control, suppress excessive actions by both sides, and prevent the war from spreading wantonly;
